periods.time: vol-15 ch-001, night before the representative war

name.zh: 法米利昂国葬与席琉斯审视一辉
name.en: Vermillion funeral and Sirius judges Ikki

periods.summary: Vermillion holds a noisy state funeral for the war dead, and Sirius explains the tradition to Ikki before confronting him about letting Stella face lethal awakening danger without rescue.
periods.cause: Vermillion mourns casualties from the Quedland army battle while preparing for the next day's representative war; Sirius has heard from the Black Knight about Ikki stopping Edelweiss from helping Stella.
periods.process: Citizens feast, drink and dance around the funeral pyre so the dead will hear the living laugh. Sirius tells Ikki this custom keeps the dead from regretting that their deaths caused sorrow. He then angrily demands why Ikki did not save Stella. Ikki admits he stopped Edelweiss and explains that because he loves Stella, he could not interfere with her resolve to remain the Crimson Princess and confront her own limits.
periods.outcome: Sirius cannot accept Ikki's reasoning as a father, but he upholds the royal promise: if Ikki wants to marry Stella, he must silence Sirius with his sword, not words. Astrea then arrives with urgent news from League headquarters.
periods.aftermath: The League border crisis news leads into the revelation that Naseem attacks the League army, sharpening the stakes for the next day.
periods.significance: Shows Vermillion's culture of defiant mourning and frames Ikki's acceptance by Stella's family as a sword-and-war trial.
